name: translatv
description: Realtime translated video chat. Two person rooms, WebRTC media, live translated subtitles.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && (npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client)
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client && npm run test:script
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run check:dashes && npm run check:copy && npm run check:wire && npm run check:spend-view && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:py
